prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1229; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck while turning left. Diagnosis is cervical strain. Over the course of care the patient attended 27 visits for conservative management, including manual therapy, stretching, and a home exercise program. Treatment followed a usual and expected course, with frequency tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion increased. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury to the neck. No prior injury to the cervical region is known to this provider. Whether the presenting injury is fully attributable to this collision remains to be determined, as the timing and mechanism are still under review. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated charges identified. Patient is currently discharged from active care with instructions to continue self-directed exercise and return if symptoms recur.
